changes.text: Telegram and other notifications no longer fail with "fetch failed" on slow internet that takes over 250 ms to connect
a destination that can't be reached now names the host and each address tried instead of "fetch failed"
Telegram errors show Telegram's own reason, point at a bad bot token, and name a supergroup's new chat ID
Telegram alerts held back by its rate limit now wait it out instead of being dropped after three quick retries
Storage ROI and every number on the Watch tab now follow the date range picker
ROI and Watch counts now include plays of titles that were later re-added or merged
Most Watched counts the same plays as ROI, the Watch stats and a title page, by media identity
Imported play history counts on the Library tabs, including titles no longer in the library
Imported plays of a title with the same name and year as a library title count as that title
Most Watched counts each play of two minutes or more, a resumed watch once, like the title pages, not runtime watched
